package.name: pointcloud_ground_filter_cpp
package.description: Per-scan RANSAC ground-plane segmentation for LiDAR clouds feeding NDT scan matching. C++ implementation using PCL — replacement for the earlier Python prototype, which spent most of its time in sensor_msgs_py.point_cloud2 conversion (~500ms/100k-point scan) and caused system-wide real-time backlog. PCL pcl::fromROSMsg + SACSegmentation typically completes in a few ms per scan.
